title: helm(private): validate values schema + init hooks for encryption/tolerations; improve upgrade/rollback
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Private deployments observed a class of upgrade failures when optional values (encryption.kmsKeyId, nodeAffinity, tolerations) were omitted or set using legacy keys. This PR tightens the values schema, adds explicit templating guards and init-job hooks to ensure required secrets/config maps exist before workload pods start. It also improves Helm upgrade/rollback behavior by making init hooks idempotent and tolerant of partial state to reduce deadlock during failed upgrades.

What changed (high-level):
- Add a consolidated values.schema.json for the redwood chart that enumerates encryption.*, tolerations and nodeSelector fields and marks deprecated keys as removed with migration hints.
- Add chart helpers to render conditional init jobs: init-encryption-job and init-tolerations-check. These jobs run as pre-install/pre-upgrade hooks when relevant values are set.
- Make init hooks idempotent: they now use kubectl-style server-side apply semantics via annotations and tolerate AlreadyExists errors in templates.
- Improve templates to guard against nil values and to normalize legacy keys (values.alpha.* -> values.*).
- Add upgrade notes and post-install hooks to surface manual migration steps when automatic migration is not possible.

Testing:
- Unit: helm template + schema validation run in CI (helm lint + jsonschema)
- Integration: smoke deploys to staging (VPC) and air-gapped lab, verified init jobs complete and regular workloads become Ready.
- E2E: simulated failed upgrade scenario to verify rollback does not leave pods stuck waiting on init jobs.

Release/Upgrade notes:
- The values.schema.json is stricter: users with custom values that used legacy keys will see validation errors on `helm upgrade --install`. Migration hints are included in validation errors.
- For clusters with existing encrypted volumes, set encryption.kmsKeyId to the current key before upgrading to avoid the init job prompting for manual reconciliation.

Checklist: 
- [x] Schema added and tested
- [x] Init hooks implemented and idempotent
- [x] Templates updated with guards and migration helpers
- [x] CI integration for lint + jsonschema
- [x] Docs/release notes entry (short)

References: ENG-4872 (private installer reliability), ENG-5120 (helm upgrade hardening), SUP-314 (customer report).
